_note: GENERATED BACKGROUND PLATES, CACHED PER CAMPAIGN. A plate is generated once and reused by every content state of that fixture — Matchday, Lineup, Half Time, Full Time all sit on the same artwork, which is what makes them read as one campaign and also what stops the club paying for the same image four times. `locked` means a human chose this candidate; nothing may overwrite a locked plate automatically. Plates contain NO text, crests, sponsor marks or scores — those are deterministic overlays. Provenance is recorded so it is always clear which artwork was machine-generated.
